verdict.rationale: Zep documents a broad programmatic surface: SDK calls for users, threads, messages, graph search and edge/node deletion, plus the zepctl CLI, which claims "full access to Zep" for users, threads, Context Graphs and data operations. Nothing in the evidence states that every dashboard capability is exposed through the API, and dashboard users are governed separately by RBAC, so parity is not shown. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of dashboard administration (dashboard RBAC, API key management, audit logs), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: It provides full access to Zep, enabling you to manage users, threads, Context Graphs, and data operations from the terminal.
Deleting a User will delete all Threads and thread artifacts associated with that User with a single API call
Chat messages are added to threads using `thread.add_messages`, which both adds those messages to the thread history and ingests those messages into the user-level knowledge graph.
